The '''feudal era''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] history, set sometime before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. ''[[The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma]]'', a play, was set during this period.
